description: This Java source file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements logging functionality by wrapping Android's native Log utility. It forwards log messages to the Android log system and optionally to the next node in a logging chain.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that implements LogNode, providing a wrapper around Android's Log utility for flexible logging chains.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list for logging.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to forward log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable; then passes to the next node if available.
